bias.en: Bearish · sitting on the $612 August high, RSI near 30
bias.zh: 偏空 · 守在 8 月高点 $612，RSI 接近 30

read.en: Meta fell 1.2% on Oct 28 to $612.49, trading between $609.00 and $624.42 on 1.7 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($630.9), 10-day ($669.8) and 30-day ($710.5) averages, the rising 100-day ($631.0) and the falling 200-day ($632.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($708.54), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: Meta 10月28日下跌 1.2%，收于 $612.49，盘中区间 $609.00–624.42，成交量为均量的 1.7 倍。股价低于下行的 5 日（$630.9）、10 日（$669.8）和 30 日均线（$710.5）、上行的 100 日均线（$631.0）以及下行的 200 日均线（$632.1）。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$708.54），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The low dipped to $609 but the close held at $612.4 (Aug 11 high); the 100 and 200-day remain resistance. Resistance is $619.2–624.4 (Oct 27 low, Oct 28 high), then $630.9–632.1 (5, 100 and 200-day) and $639.7 (Oct 22 low). Support is $609–612.4, then $600 (Jan 20 low) and $577.1 (Jul 9 low). A close below $609 would open $600; above $632, $640.
